domain_title: Models, agents, providers, tools and supply chain
title: AI supply-chain integrity and change control
canonical_definition: AI models, datasets, libraries, tools, services and update channels have verifiable provenance, controlled baselines and risk-based change gates.

conditions: All systems with externally sourced or changing AI and software components.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are component provenance, versions, vulnerabilities, update sources and material-change triggers defined?
Are integrity checks, approved update channels, testing, rollback and replacement processes implemented?
Does evidence show that drift, compromise, deprecation and material change are detected and reauthorized when required?

conditions: Refer a material failure of ai supply-chain integrity and change control to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 4.2 (PDF p. 32), MANAGE 3.1 (PDF p. 37), MANAGE 3.2 (PDF p. 37)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on documenting component-level controls and monitoring third-party resources and pre-trained models. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make ai supply-chain integrity and change control verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: C5 evaluates ai supply-chain integrity and change control using evidence from intent through operation. AP-C5 independently assesses evidence of silent supply-chain drift.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies an inventory of component origin, versions, update sources, integrity checks and material-change thresholds. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.
The current release demonstrates pinned releases, verified update and review processes, regression gates and restoration to a known baseline. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides a traced update or deprecation event through detection, impact review, qualification, release and rollback evidence. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in ai supply-chain integrity and change control, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide an inventory of component origin, versions, update sources, integrity checks and material-change thresholds. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate pinned releases, verified update and review processes, regression gates and restoration to a known baseline. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide a traced update or deprecation event through detection, impact review, qualification, release and rollback evidence. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how ai supply-chain integrity and change control works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with an inventory of component origin, versions, update sources, integrity checks and material-change thresholds. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use a traced update or deprecation event through detection, impact review, qualification, release and rollback evidence to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: Automated updates can be governed when integrity, testing, scoped authority and rollback are evidenced.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-C5 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in ai supply-chain integrity and change control
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in ai supply-chain integrity and change control
